response.sql: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_timing_ownership, AVG(t.avg_ownership - o.avg_ownership) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM timing_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.avg_ownership

assumptions.assumption: “Above average” means above the average ownership across all non-missing ownership records.

alternatives.interpretation: Compare each timing’s average with the equally weighted mean of the timing averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH timing_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS avg_ownership FROM timing_averages) SELECT AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_timing_ownership, AVG(t.avg_ownership - b.avg_ownership) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM timing_averages t CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE t.avg_ownership > b.avg_ownership
